entities.name: Kalan
entities.description: City on the Craggy Coast of southern Jamuraa, ruled by a king, famed for cavalry and bathhouses.

entities.name: Bryce
entities.description: City friendly with Kalan, subjugated at the Battle of Bryce.

entities.name: Battle of Bryce
entities.description: Battle after which Hazezon called for aid.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Sent requests for aid to the Craggy Coast cities.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Rising Emperor threatening subjugation of the coast.

entities.name: Battle of Palmyra
entities.description: Battle to which Kalan sent cavalry and sappers.

events.summary: Kalan answers Hazezon's call to arms, sending cavalry and sappers to the Battle of Palmyra.
events.quote: Kalan responded to Hazezon's call to arms, sending cavalry and sappers to participate in the Battle of Palmyra .

relations.note: Kalan has friendly relations with Bryce.
Kalan is on the Craggy Coast.
relations.quote: Kalan is a city on the Craggy Coast of southern Jamuraa
